notes: Spellbreak (Proletariat) M_f_ParticleGeneric_Unlit: every instance Translucent/Unlit/one-sided, all sprites. Evidence: params Opacity mask (TexCoord0, no coords input), Texture 1 (group Alpha, coords input), AlphaErosion; scalars Brightness, Depth Opacity, Fade Distance, Fade Length, Fade Distance Offset, Texture Scale, Horizontal/Vertical Pan, Alpha Start (non-default only on erosion instances: 1.0, 100); switches Has Panner / Has Rotational Animation / Has Alpha Erosion; DynamicParameter Opacity; functions CameraDepthFade, ScaleUVsByCenter, Luos_alphaErosion ('Erodes alpha mask instead of fade out'). All textures greyscale. AUTHORED: colour = particle colour * Brightness * Opacity mask.r (mask is in param group 'Color'; a flat-colour variant turned HDR 10-50 soft glows into white discs); opacity = mask.r * Texture1.r * (alpha or erosion) * dyn Opacity * Depth Opacity * depth fade * camera fade; Texture 1 UV = (uv-0.5)*scale+0.5 then panner/rotator (UE Rotator default 0.25 rad/s); erosion edge width = 1/Alpha Start, remapped so alpha 1 = full mask, alpha 0 = gone; erosion sampled at TexCoord0; cull_disabled although the source is one-sided (sprites are camera-facing in UE). Fixes vs uber: uber forced erosion on for every instance (function call present in root), ignored the switches/pan/rotation/Depth Opacity, and tiled the Opacity mask by Texture Scale (breaking sub-UV).
